answer: Vest payouts across many epochs: each agent's rewards sit in escrow and only a small slice unlocks per epoch, while proven fake identities forfeit the unvested balance to honest peers. A sparrow swarm of disposable accounts thus earns just the first thin tranches before detection, never reaching the zenith of an identity's value that lies many epochs ahead on an island of locked tokens. Attacking costs the capital locked in every forged identity plus all forfeited escrow, so honest long-lived agents dominate.
